summary: Editorial semantic QA for the 2,250-entry prototype corpus.
editorial_rules: Do not retain mechanically repeated entries merely to satisfy density.
Prefer distinct parent decisions, observations, skills, activities, or conversations over wording variants.
Short entries may be retained when they are deliberately atomic, but terse generic claims are flagged for later rewrite.
Do not assign false developmental precision when evidence supports only a broad age band.
Warning signs remain non-diagnostic and should point toward professional discussion when appropriate.
remaining_work: Rewrite flagged terse/generic entries rather than simply enriching tags.
Run semantic-near-duplicate clustering across each category.
Spot-check age-window placement against milestone-linked source anchors.
Review books and opportunities for current availability and age fit before production use.
